ability.eventhorizon.pull.description: Tactic: Pull → Pulse. Loose items gather at the anchor, not directly into your inventory.
ability.eventhorizon.pulse.description: Tactic: group enemies with Pull first. Solid walls protect targets from the wave.
ability.eventhorizon.blink.description: Tactic: close into Pulse range or escape a crowd. A failed blink never spends energy.
ability.eventhorizon.singularity.descrip: Tactic: build resonance with ordinary modes. Use a Flux Cell if you need energy for the finisher.
tooltip.eventhorizon.gauntlet: A tuned focus for four gravity modes.
tooltip.eventhorizon.controls: Right-click: cast · R: mode · V: guide
tooltip.eventhorizon.safe: Players/passives protected by default; pets & teammates always safe.
tooltip.eventhorizon.core: The anchor of a field's impossible mass.
tooltip.eventhorizon.manual: A compact field guide to gravity.
message.eventhorizon.busy: A field is already active or the server field limit is reached.
guide.eventhorizon.title: Field Manual
guide.eventhorizon.subtitle: GRAVITY ARSENAL / FIELD NOTES
guide.eventhorizon.basics: Right-click: cast · R: mode. Held gauntlet: +1 flux/4 ticks; cell: +60.
guide.eventhorizon.combo: First mode: 1. Each different next mode within 8s of the last adds 1 (max 3; PULL-PULSE-PULL works). Repeating the last resets to 1; singularity spends 3.
guide.eventhorizon.safety: Players and passive mobs are protected by default (server configurable). Pets and teammates are always safe. Abilities never change blocks; normal world hazards still apply.
guide.eventhorizon.pull: Aim at an enemy, loose item or surface up to 18 blocks away. A 6-block-radius field pulls targets to its anchor for 1.5 seconds. Pull itself deals no damage.
guide.eventhorizon.pulse: A wave centered on you: 8-block radius, 10 base damage and heavy knockback. Each existing resonance charge adds 15% damage.
guide.eventhorizon.blink: Travel up to 12 blocks along your aim, landing only on safe solid ground. The entire path must be clear. Walls, fluids and the world border block the jump.
guide.eventhorizon.singularity: Requires 3 resonance. An 8-block-radius field pulls enemies for 4 seconds, then collapses for up to 34.8 damage, falling off toward the edge. One active singularity per player; no terrain damage.
advancement.eventhorizon.root.title: The Quiet Edge
advancement.eventhorizon.root.descriptio: Find amethyst; let the first field take shape.
advancement.eventhorizon.gauntlet.title: A Hand Beyond
advancement.eventhorizon.gauntlet.descri: Bind a gravity core into the gauntlet.
